[Rigidity when forward and backward asymptotic solitons agree] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0184, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0185, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0186 ↗ thm:chow-iv-type-i-ancient-asymptotic-shrinkers ↗ prop:chow-iv-shrinker-backward-limit-isometric ↗ cor:chow-iv-type-i-singular-time-reduced-volume 1. ch30:30.33\group Type I Ancient Solutions

If the forward and backward asymptotic solitons in Theorem 4 are isometric as Ricci flows, then each is isometric to the original ancient solution.
